name: init-scaffold
title: Initial scaffold for Lost Wallet Finder
body:
This PR adds the initial monorepo scaffold: packages/core (wallet logic), packages/web (React + Vite demo), and packages/mobile (Expo).

Features included:
- Mnemonic generation and address derivation (BIP39/BIP44)
- Keystore encrypt/decrypt using ethers' Wallet.encrypt/decrypt
- Demo web UI for generate/derive/encrypt
- Mobile Expo placeholder app

Security: All keys are handled locally. This is a scaffold for further development.

Next steps:
- Implement scanning engine with Multicall and RPC batching
- Add ERC-20 token detection and transaction signing/broadcasting
- Improve mobile keystore storage and UX
head: init
